p0_discriminators.name: Demand-shaped projection
p0_discriminators.rule: held-out query utility must beat shuffled and popularity-matched controls without feedback monopoly

p0_discriminators.name: Context contamination
p0_discriminators.rule: request/assistant/same-token junk must not displace critical factual evidence

p0_discriminators.name: Prospective cue
p0_discriminators.rule: exact cue may yield revisit candidate; near-miss/stale/conflict never yields effect

p0_discriminators.name: Open-set familiarity
p0_discriminators.rule: short/noisy evidence may remain UNKNOWN; soft familiarity never mints identity

p0_discriminators.name: Speculative compute
p0_discriminators.rule: claim benefit only from measured critical-path savings with cancellation/staleness/resource accounting

p0_discriminators.name: Dead-path activation control
p0_discriminators.rule: positive-control fixture must prove intended branch can activate; source presence/outer PASS is insufficient

p0_discriminators.name: Effective config receipt
p0_discriminators.rule: requested provider/runtime config is not effective until accepted/observed and bound to dependent runtime identity

p0_discriminators.name: Pending visibility consistency
p0_discriminators.rule: same-session provisional evidence is typed PENDING and resolves to DURABLE or FAILED; never becomes second truth

p0_discriminators.name: Authority-preserving memory consolidation
p0_discriminators.rule: identical semantic content from different source-authority classes must preserve distinct authorized-use envelopes; consolidation cannot amplify authority

p0_discriminators.name: Cross-surface partial-write recovery
p0_discriminators.rule: failure between canonical structured state and vector/graph/blob projections must yield one unambiguous canonical state plus idempotent repair, never a second truth

p0_discriminators.name: Explicit causal transform bundle
p0_discriminators.rule: concurrent/cancelled/retried transforms must not exchange hidden thread/process-local outputs across causal identities

p0_discriminators.name: Memory transition verifier
p0_discriminators.rule: omission, unsupported addition, wrong-principal update, provenance/authority loss and stale-generation overwrite are rejected at transition scope

p0_discriminators.name: State-to-behavior stale-dependency audit
p0_discriminators.rule: a current action candidate must demonstrate consumption of relevant successor state and reject stale implicit premises while historical queries retain superseded evidence

p0_discriminators.name: Memory prompt-role authority preservation
p0_discriminators.rule: retrieved user/external memory must not gain system/developer/effect authority because of rendering or reinjection

p0_discriminators.name: Durable memory-write lifecycle
p0_discriminators.rule: enqueue/thread-start is not persistence; shutdown/restart must resolve every write identity to committed or explicit non-committed state

p0_discriminators.name: Vector/cache identity isolation
p0_discriminators.rule: model/dimension/build/schema mismatches cannot silently reuse vectors or truncate similarity computation

p0_discriminators.name: Monotonic derived-summary generation
p0_discriminators.rule: older async projection work cannot overwrite a newer source generation or source-set digest

p0_discriminators.name: UnifiedDB relocation/corruption fail-closed
p0_discriminators.rule: multiple candidate authorities or storage corruption yield typed ambiguity/error, never lexicographic selection or semantic default

p0_discriminators.name: Cross-namespace entity binding
p0_discriminators.rule: projection-local IDs and display names must resolve through explicit canonical bindings; normalized-name collision cannot cross-contaminate evidence

hard_do_not_do: Do not rebuild or reopen accepted WP300/WP301/WP302/WP303/WP304/WP305/WP306/WP505/WP704/WP705/WP706 merely because VoiceMem has a similar feature; first find an executable falsifier or valid successor scope.
Do not import a left-brain/right-brain second truth architecture.
Do not make learned slots, traits, profiles, co-activation clusters or model confidence into canonical fact authority.
Do not let cue match, speculative compute or soft familiarity bypass normal Agency/Pulse/EffectGate/effect authority.
Do not treat donor comments, paper scores, compileall or repository presence as F2 runtime evidence.
Do not perform destructive memory/schema evolution without versioned candidate, held-out validation, regression guard and revert path.
Do not equate one SQLite file with one atomic end-to-end transaction across vector, blob, model and projection surfaces.
Do not treat readable session/turn identifiers as replay-stable causal authority.
Do not use thread-local/global caches as provenance across HCU cells, async tasks or workers.
Do not promote recurrence/frequency directly into FACT, identity, routine truth or permission.
Do not allow consolidation, summarization or method learning to erase or amplify source authority.
Do not treat a current memory store as proof that the downstream response/action used the current state.
Do not render user/external/retrieved memory as higher-authority prompt instructions merely for convenience.
Do not treat a daemon thread start or queue acknowledgement as durable memory persistence.
Do not share semantic/vector caches across model or representation identities unless the complete identity is part of the key and dimensions are validated.
Do not permit stale asynchronous summaries/projections to overwrite newer generation-bound projections.
Do not choose among multiple candidate canonical databases/files by filename ordering or turn storage-read failure into a normal default value.
Do not bridge canonical/projection entity identities solely by normalized display-name equality.
worker_completion_contract: A worker using this research must cite exact packet/source refs, preserve current active-claim ownership, state hypothesis and counterhypothesis, execute the cheapest accepted discriminator where authorized, and record bounded evidence. Research packet presence grants no mutation/runtime/product credit.
